_about: "You got me Lobster?" match rules (core/tcg/match_state.gd), locked in diary/DECISIONS_TCG.md. hero_health: a leader's health. mana_max: the most mana crystals (one more each own turn from 1). deck_size / copies / legendary_copies: deck legality (the leader is extra). first_hand / second_hand: opening cards; the second player also gets lucky_card. hand_max: a card drawn into a full hand burns. board_max: creatures a side. mulligans: redraws allowed at the start. fatigue_start: damage of the first draw from an empty deck, one more each time. power_cost: a leader's hero power (once a turn). turn_seconds / fuse_seconds: the turn timer and when its fuse shows (the table enforces it). max_factions: factions a deck may mix (neutral free). max_traps: hidden traps (Club) one side may have set at once. set: the locked shape of the full set (cards per faction, neutral cards, leaders per faction, cards per rarity; tokens not counted), checked by tools/tcg_rules_check.
